title: Hundreds of Cases Opened and Indictments Issued in Connection with Two Recent Wars
content:
According to HRANA, citing Mizan, Judiciary spokesperson Seyed Ali Kazemi said during a press conference addressing the latest status of cases related to what he described as “actions against the country’s security and national interests” that 476 cases have so far been opened in connection with the two recent wars.

Kazemi added that proceedings in these cases are ongoing in prosecutors’ offices and courts, and that additional cases are being opened as new complaints are filed.

He continued: “So far, 163 indictments have also been issued in connection with these two wars.” In another part of his remarks, addressing cases involving allegations of collaboration with Israel and hostile countries, Kazemi said: “In this regard, 250 cases have been opened, involving 1,895 defendants.”

According to Kazemi, 94 of the defendants are media workers, while 1,801 are private individuals. The Judiciary spokesperson also announced that 70 indictments have so far been issued in connection with these individuals.

title: Mohsen Khalesi Sentenced to 15 Years in Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Mohsen Khalesi was sentenced to prison.

According to information obtained by HRANA, Mohsen Khalesi was sentenced to 15 years in prison by Branch 1 of the Sabzevar Revolutionary Court, presided over by judicial advisors Gholamreza Akbari-Moghadam and Hossein Yazdankhah, on charges of “cooperating with hostile states” and “intentionally setting fire to premises with the intent to confront the Islamic Republic.”

An informed source close to Mr. Khalesi’s family told HRANA that five years of the sentence have been suspended for a period of five years.

Previously, following the issuance of an indictment, his case was referred to the aforementioned judicial branch for review.

An informed source had also previously told HRANA that the prisoner, who has bipolar disorder and whose mental health had deteriorated, had made several unsuccessful suicide attempts in prison. During his detention in Sabzevar Prison, prison authorities also submitted five requests for his transfer and hospitalization, all of which were denied by the judge handling the case.
snippet: According to HRANA, Mohsen Khalesi was sentenced to prison.

title: A Prisoner Executed in Jiroft Prison
content:
According to HRANA, citing the Balochistan Human Rights Documentation Network, a prisoner was executed in Jiroft Prison at dawn today, Wednesday, October 7, 2026.

He has been identified as Abbas Anjamrooz, 28, a resident of Jiroft.

According to the report, Abbas Anjamrooz was arrested approximately five years ago on a murder charge stemming from an altercation involving a firearm and was subsequently sentenced to death by a judicial authority.

As of the time of this report, the prisoner’s execution has not been officially announced by prison authorities or other relevant institutions.

According to HRA’s Annual Report, in 2025 at least 2,063 citizens, including 61 women and 2 juvenile offenders, were executed. Of these, the sentences of 11 individuals were carried out in public. During the same period, 172 other individuals were sentenced to death.

title: Yadollah Mataei Arrested in Dehgolan
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Yadollah Mataei was arrested in Dehgolan, located in Kurdistan province.

According to the report, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026, security forces arrested Mr. Mataei on a street in Dehgolan without presenting a judicial warrant.

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the reasons for his arrest, the charges against him, or his place of detention.

The report states that Mr. Mataei had previously been arrested during the nationwide protests of 2022 and was temporarily released several weeks later after posting bail. He was subsequently sentenced to a five-year suspended prison term. He was also summoned by a security agency in April/May 2024.

Yadollah Mataei, 45, is a karate instructor with 31 years of experience in sports. He has been active in karate as an athlete and instructor since 1995.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Yadollah Mataei was arrested in Dehgolan, located in Kurdistan province.

title: January 2026 Protests: Mohsen Babaeian Sentenced to Death
content:
Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Babaeian was sentenced to death on the charge of “moharebeh” (enmity against God) by Branch 26 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Iman Afshari. The ruling was communicated to Mohsen Babaeian yesterday.

Mohsen Babaeian is currently being held in Greater Tehran Prison.

HRANA is reviewing further details regarding his case, the date of his arrest, and the judicial proceedings against him.

He was previously arrested during the January 2026 protests.

title: Saina Eslami Arrested in Yasuj
content:
According to HRANA, Saina Eslami has been arrested.

Saina Eslami is a native and resident of Yasuj.

title: January 2026 Protests: Barzou Rezaei Sentenced to Death
content:
According to HRANA, Barzou Rezaei has been sentenced to death.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Rezaei was sentenced to death by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court on the charge of “collaboration with hostile states.” The ruling was recently communicated to Barzou Rezaei’s attorney.

A hearing on the charges against him was held at this branch approximately two months ago.

Barzou Rezaei, a resident of Kermanshah, was arrested in March 2026 in connection with the nationwide protests and subsequently transferred to Greater Tehran Prison.

HRANA is reviewing further details regarding the proceedings in his case and any other potential charges brought against him.

title: Report on the Arrest of Shahrouz Sadidi in Sabzevar
content:
According to HRANA, Shahrouz Sadidi was arrested by IRGC Intelligence agents in Sabzevar on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Sadidi was transferred to Sabzevar Prison following his arrest and is currently being held in solitary confinement in the prison’s quarantine ward. A one-month temporary detention order has been issued for him.

Shahram Sadidi, his brother, also stated in a published post that a security-related case has been opened against Shahrouz Sadidi at Branch 1 of the Investigation Office of the Sabzevar Prosecutor’s Office, presided over by investigator Golestani. He is facing a charge of “propaganda against the regime.”

As of the time of this report, no information has been obtained regarding the specific grounds underlying the charge against him.

Shahrouz Sadidi was previously arrested on November 30, 2025, along with his sister, Shokouh Sadidi, by agents of the Sabzevar Ministry of Intelligence. The two were released after several hours of interrogation and after signing a written pledge.
snippet: According to HRANA, Shahrouz Sadidi was arrested by IRGC Intelligence agents in Sabzevar on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: Reza Mostafaei Arrested and Transferred to Dehdasht Prison
content:
According to HRANA, Reza Mostafaei was arrested on Saturday, October 3, 2026.

Based on information received by HRANA, Mr. Mostafaei had previously been summoned to Branch 6 of the Prosecutor’s Office of Kohgiluyeh County on a charge of “propaganda against the regime.” Yesterday, after appearing at the branch, he was arrested due to his inability to post bail set at eight billion tomans and was transferred to Dehdasht Prison.

An informed source close to his family confirmed the news to HRANA and said that the assistant prosecutor handling the case, Mr. Paydar, made demeaning remarks toward Mr. Mostafaei during the session in reference to his mobility disability and physical condition. According to the source, the assistant prosecutor also questioned him about writing slogans and his support for the families of those killed during the protests.

The source further stated that Reza Mostafaei suffers from spinal problems and a physical disability, and that his transfer to prison has heightened concerns among his family and those close to him regarding his health.
snippet: According to HRANA, Reza Mostafaei was arrested on Saturday, October 3, 2026.
sourceDescription: Human Rights Activists News Agency Hrana – News Agency | Human Rights Activists News Agency

title: HRA Investigation Exposes How Digital Matchmaking Platforms Facilitate Child Marriage in Iran
content:
HRANA News Agency – A new investigation by Human Rights Activists (HRA) documents how Iran’s “Adam and Eve” matchmaking platform allows minors to be presented as prospective spouses, while operating within a broader system of state licensing, promotion, financial incentives, and institutional support. The report also examines the role of international technology companies—including Google and Meta—in distributing and promoting services that may expose children to marriage, exploitation, and other forms of harm.

Human Rights Activists (HRA) has published a new investigative report, Child Marriage in the Digital Age, examining how digital matchmaking services in Iran are creating new pathways through which child marriage can be facilitated and normalized.

title: Attorney Bahareh Aghaei Sentenced to 20 Years in Prison
content:
According to HRANA, attorney Bahareh Aghaei has been sentenced to prison.

Based on information received by HRANA, Aghaei was recently sentenced to 20 years in prison by Branch 26 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court, presided over by Judge Iman Afshari, on charges including “propaganda activities against national security,” under Article 4 of the Law on Intensifying Punishments for Crimes Against National Security.

Bahareh Aghaei was arrested following the January 2026 protests and subsequently transferred to Qarchak Prison in Varamin. During her detention, she was held in solitary confinement at the prison for at least 15 days.

Bahareh Aghaei is a licensed attorney and a student of international law at the University of Tehran.
snippet: According to HRANA, attorney Bahareh Aghaei has been sentenced to prison.

title: Faramarz Saedi Arrested in Dehgolan
content:
According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Faramarz Saedi was arrested by security forces on a street in Dehgolan, Kurdistan province, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026.

According to the report, Mr. Saedi was arrested without a judicial warrant and subjected to violence during his arrest. He was subsequently transferred to the Ministry of Intelligence’s detention facility in Dehgolan for interrogation.

At the time of this report, the reasons for his arrest and the charges against him remain unknown.
snippet: According to HRANA, citing Kurdpa, Faramarz Saedi was arrested by security forces on a street in Dehgolan, Kurdistan province, on Tuesday, October 6, 2026.

title: Death-Row Political Prisoner Barzou Rezaei Transferred to Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj
content:
According to HRANA, the news agency of Human Rights Activists in Iran, Barzou Rezaei, a prisoner sentenced to death, has been transferred to Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj.

According to information received by HRANA, on Wednesday, October 7, 2026, Rezaei was transferred from the Greater Tehran Prison to Ghezel Hesar Prison in Karaj without prior notice. The reasons for his transfer remain unknown.

Mr. Rezaei was recently sentenced to death by Branch 23 of the Tehran Revolutionary Court on the charge of “collaboration with hostile governments.” The verdict was communicated to his lawyer following its issuance.

Barzou Rezaei, a resident of Kermanshah, was arrested in March 2026 in connection with the nationwide protests of January 2026. Following his arrest, he was transferred to the Greater Tehran Prison.
